hook: Your Ashoka emblem is pressed into the Moon's soil.
title: India's Rover Stamped Its Logo On The Moon
description:
ISRO's Pragyan rover, which landed on the Moon with Chandrayaan-3 in 2023, had wheels designed to imprint the ISRO logo and the Ashoka emblem into the lunar soil as it rolled. Series: Wait, What? Space.

#Shorts #ISRO #Chandrayaan3
comment_prompt: Proud of ISRO? Yes or no

scenes.narration: Your Ashoka emblem is pressed into the Moon's soil.
scenes.headline: INDIA ON THE MOON

scenes.narration: India's Pragyan rover landed on the Moon.
scenes.headline: PRAGYAN ROVER

scenes.narration: Its wheels carried the ISRO logo.
scenes.headline: ISRO LOGO WHEELS

scenes.narration: They also carried the Ashoka emblem.
scenes.headline: ASHOKA EMBLEM

scenes.narration: Every roll pressed them into the lunar soil.
scenes.headline: STAMPED WHILE ROLLING

scenes.narration: There is no wind on the Moon to wipe them.
scenes.headline: NO WIND TO ERASE

scenes.narration: Chandrayaan-3 landed near the Moon's south pole.
scenes.headline: SOUTH POLE LANDING

scenes.narration: India was the first country to land there.
scenes.headline: FIRST TO LAND THERE

scenes.narration: So India's mark really sits on the Moon.
scenes.headline: TOTALLY REAL
